brief:
Israeli occupation forces have begun demolishing a second home in Kafr ad-Dik, west of Salfit, Eye on Palestine reported. The demolition is part of an ongoing campaign targeting Palestinian residences in the town.

The operation continues a pattern of house demolitions in the community. Details on the reason for the demolitions or the number of residents affected were not immediately available.
dek: Israeli occupation forces continue demolitions in Kafr ad-Dik, west of Salfit, where they have begun demolishing a second home as part of an ongoing campaign targeting Palestinian homes in the town.
title: Israeli forces demolish second home in Kafr ad-Dik
